1. **P1 — Scaffold generation overwrites existing work.**  
   [provider_scaffold.ex:49](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/dev/provider_scaffold.ex:49) writes every file without a conflict check. Repeating the command replaces edited files. The guide’s `google_sheets` example also targets an existing package in this umbrella. A temporary check confirmed that an existing file was replaced.  
   **Correction:** Check all destination files before writing. Stop on conflicts unless the author explicitly requests replacement.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.

comments.text: Fixed in f670ce1c on release/3.0.
